verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents a fully-managed Postgres service, but nothing in the evidence shows a serverless SQL database queried directly from code over an HTTP or driver interface without managing connections. Managed Postgres is a related but different capability, so it earns no credit here. The axis applies to a cloud platform, so the absence of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can query a serverless SQL database directly from my code with no connection management
